answer: Farming becomes a jade bet on surviving 64 epochs of grading, and every timber settlement recomputes the thread schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 12 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 64 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 4 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
